svg.title: Prisma raises $4.5M to build the GraphQL data layer for all databases
svg.desc: A translucent prism refracts a single incoming query beam into three crisp prism-coloured beams, beside the line "One query, every database" — the 2018 seed-round announcement and Prisma's mission to reach every database through one GraphQL layer. Prisma blog cover, 2026 brand.
